piper.name: PIPER
intro: I heard a song in the leaves!
Show me your Jakamon!
lose: Your friend sings louder. I like that.

moss.name: RANGER MOSS
intro: The grove is tender. Step kindly.

vesper.name: ADMIN VESPER
intro: Team Eclipse will dim this wood.
The first Sun Shard is already ours.
lose: Take the shard. The sun is still too bright for my taste.

nia.name: NIA
intro: The tide brought me a partner. Want to see?
lose: Ha! You swim better than I do.

cole.name: COLE
intro: Something sweet is on the wind. Battle first, snack after.
lose: You win. The mango smell was yours, wasn't it?

brine.name: ADMIN BRINE
intro: The sea cave hides a shard.
Eclipse will drink the daylight.
lose: The shard is yours. Do not expect the mountain to be as wet and easy.

hart.name: HART
intro: I climb until the air thins. Battle me on the way.
lose: You have a good grip. Keep going.

solene.name: SOLENE
intro: These stones remember the sun. I will test if you do.

crag.name: ADMIN CRAG
intro: The mine's shard is Eclipse property.
Turn back, little daylight.
lose: Fine. Carry the shard. The mire will swallow it.

puck.name: WARDEN PUCK
intro: Mind the mud. And mind my friend.

june.name: JUNE
intro: The swamp grows sweet things in strange places.
lose: Your Jakamon is the sweetest thing here.

mire.name: ADMIN MIRE
intro: Four shards would have been enough.
I will take yours in the mud.
lose: Go freeze, then. The north shard still laughs at you.

ren.name: REN
intro: Cold keeps me honest. Battle does too.
lose: Honest loss. I can live with that.

yuki.name: YUKI
intro: The ice cavern sings if you listen. First, we battle.
lose: Listen on the way in. The song is worth it.

frost.name: ADMIN FROST
intro: The last shard. The sun's last errand.
Team Eclipse ends the day here.
lose: Five shards. Take them to the shrine. Umbra is waiting, and so is the sun.

kai_1.name: KAI
intro: {player}! Professor Hollis let you pick first.
I took the one you didn't. Let's see who chose better.
lose: Tch. Beginner's luck. I will be stronger past the trees.

kai_2.name: KAI
intro: You already have a shard? I have a better partner.
Do not get proud, {player}.
lose: Still you. I will reach the shrine first. Watch me.

kai_3.name: KAI
intro: This is the door to Sol.
If you go in, you go in after beating me.
lose: Go. Bring the sun home. I will be right behind you.

umbra.name: UMBRA
intro: I am Umbra. Team Eclipse ends with me.
Sol eats the light and calls it supper. I will put that hunger out.
lose: The shards are awake. Sol is free to choose. I hope the sun chooses you, and not another long night.
